title: I went to the hotel I work at, and finally almost got something!
content: So I go to this hotel a lot and do housekeeping, last night I went there and I looked at a clock board that was all messed up and I'm like yeah I know I'm dreaming, and then I have a thought, I have to figure out what this place is called. You know how when you go to hotels they have shelves on every floor with a little pamphlet that says Hilton or wherever your staying. I saw 2 pamphlets, I couldn't read the first one but the second one said something like F----- Dreamscape.
